top_signals.title: Oil Prices Fall Amidst Hopes of Easing US-Iran Hostilities
top_signals.summary: Oil prices fell $2 a barrel on Monday amid hopes of easing hostilities between the United States and Iran, but persistent attacks on key producer Saudi Arabia kept investors wary and prices near six-month highs.Brent crude futures were down $2.03, or 1.7%, at $114.70 at 10:37 a.m.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.summary: Nigel Farage has said that banks should not be hit with new taxes at this week’s Budget in a partial U-turn on his previous position.  Earlier this year, the Reform UK leader vowed to scrap interest payments lenders receive on deposits at the Bank of England, a move that would be widely regarded as a [...]

top_signals.title: Serbian autocrat loses election following widespread reports of digital repression
top_signals.summary: Serbian strongman leader Aleksandar Vučić on Sunday admitted defeat in his race for prime minister, a loss that follows a series of incidents of digital repression that galvanized the opposition.
